name: Raw | Hempwick
description:
Raw Brand Hemp Wick – Natural and unbleached hemp and beeswax. Raw brand Hemp Wick is a natural alternative to lighters and matches. To use: Pull wick from the center, light end, tilt to control flame.
20ft of hemp wick
Non GMO, Chlorine Free, Vegan
